defs.score: Score 0-100: the name's place on the Skew Tracker's call list for the window (its OI skew), plus points for every other board that flags it, more for a stronger flag on that board, plus a little for ask-side buying and for a flag on its board's newest day, less for call selling and for boards that flag the name's puts.
defs.sold: A call build tagged sold (call writing at the bid) keeps only part of its OI skew points and adds no board points; a sale also costs a little when it is the OI skew's own reading or on its board's newest day. Puts tagged sold (put writing) are never counted against a name.
defs.stale: A board more than one session behind its usual timing is shown dimmed and left out of the score.
defs.main: The contract of the strongest live, unsold board flag. Its money is what that one contract took in the window: the contracts opened in it on each session at that session's closing price, added up, the Skew Tracker's bet-size way (its Bet size adds up every call contract the same way). A main from the after-close tape shows its line's new contracts at the closing price, traded but not settled yet.

families.skew: calls opened vs puts opened in the window, one-sided, as a share of the name's own book (Skew Tracker)
families.tape: the newest session's traded volume leans to calls (opens beyond the prior open interest)
families.stealth: steady, relative call building with a quiet price
families.loud: one session's unusually big call build, large in money and in contracts
families.leap: a far call pile on long-dated options that is new money
families.unusual: unusual call buying (Russell Unusual Options, its informed-look tiers)
families.ladder: a ladder of call open interest across strikes
families.hunt: a big call-GEX stack well above price with thin puts below
families.seeker: a far call node: a big call pile well above the price, calls well ahead of puts at its strike
